blocks.title: Executive Summary: 1-Sentence & 1-Paragraph Pitch (Meeting Action Item 00:15:27)
blocks.text:
**One-Sentence Pitch:** Warranty Wallet is a smart purchase and coverage assistant that captures your proofs of purchase, alerts you before warranties or trials expire, and generates ready-to-send claim packages in one tap.

**One-Paragraph Overview:** Consumers routinely lose hundreds of dollars in valid warranty coverage because paper receipts fade, email invoices get buried, and claim procedures are frustratingly complex. Validated through initial user interviews, Warranty Wallet solves this through a three-stage journey—Capture, Protect, and Claim. To deliver a rock-solid Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for the November University Investor Seminar, our initial release pairs frictionless manual/photo capture and a pre-populated brand warranty database with automated 30/7/1-day expiry alerts and a one-tap claim generator, establishing a scalable foundation that expands into AI OCR scanning and recurring student subscription tracking.
1. Critical Alignment: Resolving Conflicts Between Meeting Notes & Slides

Reviewing the October 16 meeting transcript against the current 5-slide pitch deck reveals four high-impact updates that resolve internal contradictions and make the pitch significantly stronger for investor scrutiny:

rows: **Stage 1: Capture & MVP Scope**
Relies on OCR Receipt Scanning as Feature #1 and Milestone S6.
De-risk MVP for investors by replacing OCR scanning with structured user input + photo storage first (`00:06:07`–`00:07:26`).
Reframe Feature #1 as **Quick Capture & Receipt Vault** (structured input + photo backup now; AI OCR as Phase 2 upgrade).
**Missing Warranty Data Fix**
Slide 5 says: *'Fix: defaults by product type'* without explaining how data is sourced.
Use a web-scraping tool on promotional directories (e.g., UNiDAYS-style sites) to seed a database of brands & policies (`00:03:49`–`00:05:24`).
Highlight **Pre-Seeded Brand & Statutory Warranty Database** on Slides 4 & 5 as a defensible data asset.
**Subscriptions & Monetization**
Slide 4 buries subscriptions at the end of *'Out of scope for now'*.
Position Subscription & Student Promo Tracking as the Phase 2 add-on; explore ad-supported student tier or B2B white-labeling (`00:03:06`, `00:11:31`, `00:18:19`).
Split Slide 4 bottom box into **Strictly Out of Scope** vs. **Phase 2 Expansion (Subscriptions, AI OCR, White-Label B2B)**.
**Governance & Investor Target**
Slide 5 lists generic *'Member A–D'* and *'Board and link'*.
Migrate from WhatsApp to GitHub Projects for direct AI phase tracking; formalize team contract/roles by Monday; target Nov Investor Seminar (`00:09:25`, `00:12:49`).
Add the **November Investor Seminar** milestone, **GitHub + AI workflow**, and concrete role titles on Slide 5.

items: **Refine the One-Sentence Idea:** Update *'A mobile app that scans your receipts...'* to **'A mobile app that captures and organizes your proofs of purchase, warns you before warranties expire, and automates claims in one tap.'** This keeps your core promise accurate whether capture is manual/photo (MVP) or AI OCR (Phase 2).

**Sharpen the Target Persona:** Explicitly mention **'University students, young adults, and households buying electronics and managing recurring services'** to connect directly with the student market and the November university seminar audience (`00:04:36`, `00:09:25`).

blocks.text: Slide 2: What Users Told Us (3 Anonymous Conversations)

items: **Use Person 3 to Justify the MVP Pivot:** Person 3 explicitly stated they *'Want reminders more than storage'* and struggled with a faded bill. In your pitch, explain that this insight drove the Oct 16 meeting decision (`00:06:07`) to prioritize reliable expiry alerts (`PROTECT`) and claim drafting (`CLAIM`) over spending weeks building custom OCR before user testing.
**Update 'What we changed':** Revise to **'Reminders and claim guidance now anchor our MVP; high-contrast photo backup + pre-populated brand defaults ensure faded bills never block a claim.'**

blocks.text: Slide 3 & Slide 4: Proposed Solution & Three Core Features

items: **Stage 1 (Capture) Two-Step Maturity:** Present Capture as **(a) MVP Quick-Log + Photo Vault** with auto-filled warranty durations from our scraped brand database, and **(b) AI OCR Auto-Scan** as our Phase 2 upgrade once the core claim workflow is validated (`00:06:56`).

**Upgrade the 'Out of Scope' Box on Slide 4:** Keep your strong discipline rule (*'We hold these three features until they work end to end'*), but separate **Phase 2 Platform Expansion** (Recurring Subscription & Student Deal Tracking via UNiDAYS-style scraping, plus B2B White-Labeling) from permanently excluded features.
**Add the External Investor Milestone:** Highlight the **November University Investor Seminar** (`00:09:25`) on the S3–S10 timeline as the target showcase for the functional MVP.

**Strengthen Risk Mitigation:** Under *'No warranty length on receipt'*, specify: **'Fix: Automated web scraping of brand warranty policies & statutory defaults (`00:04:36`).'** Under *'OCR misreads / AI token cost (`00:09:25`)'*, specify: **'Fix: Structured manual/photo capture first for zero-hallucination MVP reliability.'**

**Professionalize Team Ownership & Tooling:** Replace *'Board and link: Member A'* with **'GitHub Projects + AI Phase-Tracking Repo & Team Charter (`00:12:49`, `00:16:02`)'** and update *'OCR research: Member C'* to **'Brand/Subscription Scraping & OCR Feasibility: Member C'**.

blocks.text: 3. Why Warranty Wallet Beats the Alternative Meeting Concepts (Q&A Prep)

During the October 16 meeting, the team also brainstormed a Student Housing App (`00:10:35`) and a Student Budget Tracker (`00:18:19`). Using this comparative matrix in your speaker notes proves rigorous idea selection:

rows: **1. Warranty Wallet (Selected Core)**
Prevent lost coverage via receipt vault, 30/7/1-day alerts, and 1-tap claim drafting.
OCR complexity & AI token cost (solved by pivoting MVP to quick manual/photo input + scraped defaults).
**Primary MVP** for the course & November Investor Pitch.
**2. Subscription & Promo Tracker**
Track recurring subscriptions & student deals (UNiDAYS-style database).
Scope creep if built simultaneously with warranty claims in Sprint 1.
**Phase 2 Add-On Module** sharing the same alert & scraping engine (`00:03:06`).
**3. Student Budget Tracker**
Automate student expense tracking with ad-based monetization (`00:18:19`).
Crowded market and high friction without bank API integrations.
**Monetization Insight:** Adopt ad-supported free student tier + 'money saved' metric.
**4. Student Housing & White-Label App**
Public room listings + resident outage/chat board; B2B white-label skinning.
Dorms will not share live vacancy data (`00:11:07`), forcing fake placeholder listings.
**B2B Upside:** Retain the **White-Label Customization** model (`00:11:31`) for institutional partners.

blocks.text: 4. Action Checklist Before Monday Selection & Session 4

items: **GitHub Migration (`00:12:49`, `00:16:27`):** Move all proposal documents, slide drafts, and comment threads from WhatsApp into **GitHub Projects** so AI agents can directly read documentation and update phase status.

**Deep Research & Challenge Log (`00:12:10`, `00:20:08`):** Run Deep Research on existing warranty/subscription apps, document key technical or market challenges, and log peer review comments on GitHub before Monday.

**Team Contract & Role Assignment (`00:16:02`, `00:17:10`):** Finalize the written team agreement/charter on Monday and assign concrete owners to: **(1) GitHub & AI Workflow Lead**, **(2) Wireframes & UX Lead**, **(3) Brand Scraping & OCR Research Lead**, and **(4) User Interviews & Claim Copy Lead**.
